root_cause: Session-note persistence raised before client close/offline publication. The host then abandoned remaining agent disconnects, inspector shutdown, and journal release.
implementation: ScheduledAgent.disconnect joins its worker first, then defers session-note and cleanup failures while closing the fake/game client, setting online false, publishing offline, and recording only a disconnected WorldFeed event.

AgentHost.stop sets stop_flag on every agent before joining the first worker, continues every disconnect despite persistence/cleanup errors, shuts down and joins WorldFeed, then releases all journals.

Original single failures are re-raised unchanged. Multiple failures use BaseExceptionGroup, which becomes ExceptionGroup for ordinary exceptions, preserving every original exception and traceback rather than replacing or silently dropping failures.
Both producer joins are timeout-free, reject self-join, and verify the thread is no longer alive before discarding its reference.

If a join raises or returns while the producer remains alive, host retains thread references and all journal ownership; later external stop safely retries. No storage close is attempted while any owned producer can still write.
Client-close errors are propagated during disconnect rather than suppressed; the existing best-effort connect-failure cleanup default is preserved.
A failed durable note is never added to visible memory and no saved-note claim is emitted. fsync failure may leave an unacknowledged on-disk row; durability is intentionally not claimed.

test_coverage_of_requirements: Single and multiple simultaneous session-note failures preserve original exception identities.
Every fake game client closes and every agent/runtime dashboard state is offline before error reaches caller.
Event-controlled real workers finish their final writes before client/journal shutdown; every worker is signaled before the first blocked join.
Event-controlled inspector finishes its final write and is joined before any journal close; all journal locks can then be reacquired.
No post-close worker/inspector writes; journal-close guards independently record and reject unsafe ordering.
Second stop is idempotent after persistence failure, no extra notes are written, and host.step cannot reconnect stopped agents.
Interrupted/early-returning joins retain alive producers and journals until retry; self-stop from worker and inspector defers release until external join.
Real JsonlExperienceStore write and fsync failures poison the store, do not acknowledge the failed session, and still permit complete host cleanup.
A journal-close failure is reported alongside the original note error without preventing attempts to release later journals.
